title: I found a cave
content: I found two women last night which is weird, I don't normally run into or talk to people in my dreams, but someone was introducing me to them as if they were important, and the moment I met them I recognized them as "the women who run the cave". They were in their 30s or 40s, very in love, with no kids.. one dark skinned one light skinned, big and tall, thinking back these women seem sooo familiar to me, still, in my waking life. They took me to the cave, which was set up as a sort of memorial, for mothers who'd lost children before or during childbirth, or couldn't have them all together. The emotion was Soo heavy that the dream wrapped up and ended quite abruptly for me but I woke up and couldn't help but remember that part and how vivid it was. I've Never been there before that I can remember but I'm sure this will be a place revisited based on the feeling and insights given into the whys it was there. Just wanted to share
